text: 你的威胁显然让查理动摇了。她不愿白跑一趟，便趁夜里守夜时偷偷离开，带走独木舟和一份补给，算作自己的报酬。从学生的眼神中，你也看出他们对你的计划心存疑虑。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 603
text: Your threat obviously impressed Charlie. Rather than end up with nothing for this trip, she sneaks off during her watch at night, taking the canoe and a share of the supplies as settlement for her efforts. You can see from the eyes of your students that they are also uncertain about your plan.
